label: Example demo
command: opencode run --standalone --auto --archived --format json --agent tawa --title "Tawassul demo: tawa routing"
prompt: Review src/pricing.js. Name the derived specialist in this workspace that you would route a pricing bug to. Do not edit any file.

input.response:
I reviewed `src/pricing.js` (read-only — no files changed). It's a small pricing module: `lineTotal` (price × qty), `orderTotal` (subtotal × rate), and `formatTotal` (a plain `"$" + value` stringify). Potential bug surfaces here are calculation/rounding in `orderTotal` and unrounded currency formatting in `formatTotal`.

For a pricing **bug fix**, the derived specialist I'd route it to is **@dev-beam** — the workspace's derived development specialist (configured on `opencode/beam-free`). The base `@dev` is only a role template; `dev-beam` is the actual derived specialist for implementation work in this workspace.

(If it were a verification task rather than a fix, the matching derived specialists would be @tester-flint-40b-free for testing or @reviewer-longcat-2.5-free for review — but for a fix, @dev-beam is the right one.)
